## 📌 Description
<!-- Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this Pull Request -->

**Jira Ticket / Issue ID:** `#`
**Feature ID:** `FE-` (e.g., `FE-01`, `FE-03`)

## 🔄 Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature for user / driver / dispatcher / admin
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without functionality changes
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated unit / integration tests
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Build config, dependencies, CI/CD pipeline

## ✅ Quality Checklist (Branching & CI Rules)
- [ ] My code strictly adheres to the project coding style conventions.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented complex or critical business logic.
- [ ] Unit tests have been added or updated, and **all tests pass locally**.
- [ ] No compilation warnings or lint errors exist.
- [ ] Commit messages follow the convention: `[TICKET-ID] <type>: <short description>`.
- [ ] Peer review requested (minimum 1 approval required before merge into `develop`).
